description: Three exact-anchor semantic mutations for Print preflight validation contracts.
case_filters: By-object validation rejects objects inside the bed keep-out area
Layered validation honors bed and clumping keep-out areas
Estimated prime tower validation distinguishes safe, model, bed, and clumping footprints
Belt purge tower validation distinguishes By-object, By-layer, and disabled settings

mutants.test_filter: By-object validation rejects objects inside the bed keep-out area
mutants.description: Bypass the By-object bed-exclusion intersection; the test must fail through the ordinary error type, exact message, and instance-identity assertions.

mutants.test_filter: Layered validation honors bed and clumping keep-out areas
mutants.description: Ignore enable_wrapping_detection in the layered keep-out check; the explicitly disabled wrapping control must be rejected by ordinary clean-result assertions.

mutants.test_filter: Belt purge tower validation distinguishes By-object, By-layer, and disabled settings
mutants.description: Reverse the By-object purge-warning sequence guard; the By-layer enabled/disabled controls must distinguish the unexpected warning using ordinary assertions.
